cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the government's digital governance authority has issued rules for government bodies' use or purchase of AI, or published a register of its AI systems.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-13: the Kenya Revenue Authority's Shuru chatbot (KEN-002) and the Technopolis Development Authority's SecureKE security operations centre, launched with AI-enabled analytics over government networks in November 2026 (KEN-009), put AI in service in two bodies in different sectors. No cross-government rules or register for AI is held, so not 5.
